items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Johnny used to play a banjo. He died.

ctx.x: No, not Lawrence Marrero. Johnny. Okay.
Johnny used to play a banjo. He died. Johnny? What was his last name? Johnny, uh—Johnny Simon. Johnny Simon? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. His name was not Johnny.
